inv.text: Urborg is one of the first places to fall to Phyrexia, and the Stronghold is transplanted into one of its volcanoes during the Rathi Overlay.
Ebony treefolk defend the island savagely against the invaders, and a Coalition assault on the Stronghold stalls at the volcano.
For the last great battle Multani transplants part of Yavimaya to Urborg's edge, spending nearly all his power, and in its skies Yawgmoth is finally defeated.
The Weatherlight sinks near Urborg after Gerrard, Urza and Karn complete the Legacy, and Windgrace closes the time rift above the Stronghold ruins at the cost of his life.

pls.text: Urborg is where Urza takes the Weatherlight and the metathran, and where the Weatherlight also brings a Minotaur army from Hurloon so that the battle for southern Urborg is quickly won.
Agnate's metathran, caught in quicksand, are saved by Dralnu's undead and ally with them against the Phyrexians, until Agnate learns that Dralnu caused his illness in order to take his army.
Grizzlegom then mercy kills Agnate and kills Dralnu, and above the Stronghold Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec as Sisay crashes the Predator into it.
Darigaaz learns that he is the red Primeval, and the four Primevals sacrifice themselves in a tar pit, awakening Crosis.

apc.text: Urborg is where Multani transplants Yavimaya to its edge, and his troops invade Urborg, driving Crovax from his throne room.

Eladamri and Grizzlegom attack the Stronghold but are held at the Portcullis, until stone dwarves tunnel in and destroy the gate from behind, and the dwarves later erupt the dormant volcano, destroying the Stronghold, though its portal had already let Yawgmoth enter Dominaria.
Yawgmoth's cloud kills the minotaur and metathran armies on Urborg except a small group saved by Lord Windgrace.
The Rathi Overlay opens the Urborg rift, and Windgrace gives up his life to heal it, fusing his spirit to the land to watch over it.

plc.text: Urborg is where Jhoira and Venser go to seek Lord Windgrace, only for Venser to be captured by Windgrace while Jhoira meets Jodah, who explains the Weaver King.
The Weaver King was brought to Urborg with the Stronghold during the Rathi Overlay and has woven a web of mental strands for 300 years, tormenting Venser.
Karn arrives and convinces Windgrace to close the Urborg rift, and Windgrace fades from reality, apparently dead.
Venser tricks the Weaver King and kills him by rupturing powerstones, and Jeska then arrives in Urborg and asks where her mentor Karn is.
